title: Mini MURDLE — The Silent Agent
subtitle: Mini mode: 3 suspects, 3 weapons, 3 locations
storyHtml: A helpful AI agent suddenly stopped responding. The audit trail points to one consultant, one device, and one Dynavics workspace.

clues.text: Iris was in the Solution Vault.
The Token was used in the Solution Vault.
The Tablet was in the AI Studio.
Jade was not in the Support Hub.
